# PIXL 1.0.8 prerelease per-file review ledger

This ledger accounts for every enumerated source/build/runtime file and records reproducible direct-include, domain, binding, and risk-pattern scans. It is paired with the UX and subsystem reports; it is not a claim that static text scanning proves runtime behavior. Findings marked `pattern` need owner-context review; live Skyrim validation is recorded separately.
